messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: INC-1798012469 latency_slo_burn (p99) — region: eu-west-1. Trigger: p99 > 1.5s for 3m. Pager: @oncall-rotation. Links: https://pagerduty.example/INC-1798012469

mia: Ack — I'm on it, moving to the incident channel.

lucas: I see p99 spikes to ~1.8s in the grafana panel. CPU on inference nodes is fine, but KV sidecar evictions spiking.

jordan: Any deploys in the last hour?

mia: No deploys in last 2h. Checking sidecar logs:

mia: ```
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/kv-sidecar-abc | tail -n 50
OOMKilled at 2024-09-12T09:39:30Z
Evicted keys: hot_keys=12k, evictions/s=420
```

ops-lead: Probable KV thrash due to a hotkey. Two quick mitigations: 1) scale sidecar replicas; 2) enable degraded routing (route to dedicated pool). Which do we prefer for fastest restore?

lucas: Scale first. scaling should drop p99 quickly. Then we can consider routing.

mia: Running scale now: `kubectl scale deploy/kv-sidecar-abc --replicas=4 -n inference`

incident-bot: Action recorded: user mia executed kubectl scale (cmd id: cmd-8472). Metric snapshot attached.

mia: Scaled to 4. Watching metrics — p99 dropping to ~720ms after ~90s. Still seeing occasional 1.2s tails.

anna-cs: FYI CS dashboard shows a small uptick in 504s for customer AcmeCorp, ~0.3% of requests in last 5m. No open tickets yet.

jordan: Good. Can we also mute noisy non-actionable alerts to avoid pager churn? We should timebox paging while mitigations proceed.

ops-lead: I'll mute the p99 alert for 10m (timebox) while we validate scaling effect. If p99 stays <900ms, we'll re-enable with adjusted thresholds.

oncall-rotation: Handing off to lucas for monitoring in 30m. lucas — please take the bridge if things reflare.

lucas: Taking watch. Will hold on routing to dedicated unless tails persist >5m.

mia: Confirming customer impact low. I'll follow up with a short post-incident note and the hotkey analysis.

incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-1798012469 acknowledged by mia at 2024-09-12T09:42:15Z. Escalation suppressed.

lucas: :thumbsup: p99 trending down. Keeping an eye on evictions/s.

jordan: Opening postmortem draft: https://docs.example/postmortems/INC-1798012469

anna-cs: I'll ping AcmeCorp proactively with a short heads-up (no need for escalation unless errors spike).

incident-bot: Monitoring window active. Auto-close disabled. Last check 2024-09-12T09:50:05Z — p99=680ms, evictions/s=40.

mia: I'll mark as mitigated in 15m if metrics remain stable; handoff to lucas for overnight watch.

latter: End of thread.
